hero.title: 🏚️ Haunted Pub Name Generator
hero.tagline: Creaking old inns and their resident ghosts, from The Weeping Lantern to The Boo and Anchor.

article.intro: Every old inn worth its sign has a ghost story: a coachman who still waits in the yard, a fiddler heard after closing time. This **haunted pub name generator** makes spooky, old-English pub names in classic, gothic and comic styles, and can give each one its own resident ghost.

sections.heading: Eight good haunted pub names
sections.content:
All eight came from the generator:

  • The Huntsman's Lament: a classic sign with a sad story behind it.
  • The Sleepless Smuggler: haunted by a smuggler who hides lace and tea under the floorboards.
  • The Watchman's Rest: for a ghost who never finished his shift.
  • The Raven and Scythe: a gothic pair, like a real "and" pub name.
  • The Spider and Key: a gothic sign with a mystery in it.
  • The Grave Mistake: a comic name, haunted by a boggart who hides the darts.
  • The Spook and Umbrella: a cheerful pun on a pub sign.
  • The Fright and Cushion: haunted by a landlord who rattles chains and then apologises.

sections.heading: Why so many pubs have a ghost
sections.content:
Old inns had everything a ghost story needs: centuries of travellers, coaching yards, cellars and, on the coast, smugglers. Jamaica Inn on Bodmin Moor gave its name to Daphne du Maurier's 1936 smuggling novel and has had a ghostly reputation ever since.

  • Classic names follow real pub patterns, with a figure from the inn's past: a pedlar, a landlady, a fiddler.
  • Gothic names use the old "A and B" sign shape with darker things: The Rook and Coffin.
  • Comic names are ghost puns for a Halloween party: The Overworked Spectre.

Choose With its ghost and every pub comes with a resident spirit and the odd thing it does.

sections.heading: Using a haunted pub
sections.content:
• In a story or a game, the ghost is a ready-made rumour: the barkeep can tell it, and the players can investigate.
  • For a Halloween party, name the room or the bar after one and print a sign.
  • For a real pub or event, search the name first, as many classic pub names are already in use.

For an ordinary inn, try the Tavern Name Generator. For the ghost itself, there's the Ghost Name Generator, and for the house up the road, the Haunted House Name Generator.

For more spooky names, see all the Halloween name generators.

faqs.question: What are good haunted pub names?
faqs.answer: Old-English pub names with a ghost in them: The Huntsman's Lament, The Raven and Scythe, The Sleepless Smuggler. For a party, comic names like The Spook and Umbrella.

faqs.question: Why are so many old pubs said to be haunted?
faqs.answer: They're old, busy places full of travellers' stories, often with cellars, coaching yards or smuggling history, which is just what a ghost story needs.

faqs.question: Can I use these names for a D&D tavern?
faqs.answer: Yes. Choose With its ghost and you get a rumour for your players at the same time.
